narrative.intro: Clark Construction Group obligated $495M in federal contracts in FY2026 to date, across 17 awards with an average award size of $29.1M. Clark Construction Group obligations are up 0.6% year over year. The Department of Defense is the primary buyer, accounting for $415M of obligations. The General Services Administration is the second-largest buyer with $76.9M. Clark Construction Group work is concentrated in building and heavy civil markets: Commercial and Institutional Building Construction totals $316M, Other Heavy and Civil Engineering Construction totals $145M, and Site Preparation Contractors totals $33.7M. Yearly context shows that Clark Construction Group obligations ranged from $167M in FY21 to $1.6B in FY24, with FY25 at $492M and FY26 at $495M to date. The mix of large agency demand and construction-focused NAICS markets explains why average award size is $29.1M. Contractors or agencies tracking Clark Construction Group should focus on Department of Defense opportunities and major building and civil construction procurements for the remainder of the fiscal year.

sections.heading: Who are the biggest federal buyers of Clark Construction Group?
sections.body: The Department of Defense obligated $415M to Clark Construction Group in FY2026 to date. The General Services Administration obligated $76.9M. Smaller buyers include the Smithsonian Institution with $1.6M, the Department of Justice with $1.2M, the Department of Health and Human Services with $953K, and the Department of Homeland Security with $10K.

sections.heading: What markets and contract sizes dominate Clark Construction Group’s federal work?
sections.body: Commercial and Institutional Building Construction is the largest market at $316M. Other Heavy and Civil Engineering Construction follows at $145M, and Site Preparation Contractors totals $33.7M. The company received 17 awards in FY2026 to date with an average award size of $29.1M.

faq.a: Clark Construction Group has $495M in federal obligations in FY2026 to date. Clark Construction Group received 17 awards this fiscal year with an average award size of $29.1M, and obligations are up 0.6% year over year.

faq.q: Which agencies buy from Clark Construction Group?
faq.a: The Department of Defense is the largest buyer of Clark Construction Group, obligating $415M. The General Services Administration obligated $76.9M, the Smithsonian Institution obligated $1.6M, the Department of Justice obligated $1.2M, the Department of Health and Human Services obligated $953K, and the Department of Homeland Security obligated $10K.

faq.q: What does Clark Construction Group sell to the government?
faq.a: Clark Construction Group sells construction services to the government, led by Commercial and Institutional Building Construction at $316M. Clark Construction Group also sells Other Heavy and Civil Engineering Construction services at $145M and Site Preparation Contractors services at $33.7M.
